Privacy Policy

This policy explains how Lensly Eyewear Inc. ("we", "us") handles your personal information when you use our site and stores.

We collect precise location only in our mobile app, and only if you enable it. We retain your information as long as necessary.

You can ask us for a copy of what we hold about you, or ask us to delete it, by writing through the contact page. We use this information to fulfil your orders, to fit your prescription, to answer your questions and to keep the site working properly for everyone who visits it.
